name: Jumping Lunge
steps: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward, the other back, both knees bent near 90 degrees, and your torso upright.
Drive explosively upward through both feet while swinging your arms to propel yourself off the floor.
Switch your leg positions smoothly in midair so your back leg comes forward and your front leg moves back.
Land softly directly into the opposite lunge, absorbing the impact through your hips and knees, and continue alternating sides on each jump.
tips: Keep your chest tall and prevent your front knee from diving inward on landing.
Land gently so your back knee hovers above the floor without banging down.
